name: bitrise
title: Bitrise
description: Bitrise REST connector (mobile CI builds + apps). Read-only; surfaces build status, workflow id, branch and commit so the local index can correlate mobile CI runs back to PRs and incidents.

tools.name: bitrise_list
tools.description: List Bitrise resources. When `appSlug` is omitted, returns the user's accessible apps via `/v0.1/me/apps`. When `appSlug` is provided, returns the app's recent builds via `/v0.1/apps/<slug>/builds` (status filter and limit optional).

tools.name: bitrise_get
tools.description: Fetch a single Bitrise resource. When `buildSlug` is provided, returns the build via `/v0.1/apps/<appSlug>/builds/<buildSlug>`. When omitted, returns the app via `/v0.1/apps/<appSlug>`.

tools.name: bitrise_search
tools.description: Substring search across a Bitrise app's recent builds. Matches the query against `branch`, `commit_message`, `triggered_workflow`, and `status_text` (case-insensitive). Returns a `{ matches: [...] }` envelope.
